summary: Pelagos Insurance Capital Limited (formerly Fidelis Insurance Holdings) filed a Form 6-K reporting that director Charles Mathias resigned from the Board and its Risk and Investment Committees, effective August 2, 2026. Mathias, nominated by The Fidelis Partnership under Bye-Law 54.3(a)(iv), had his successor designated by that entity under Bye-Law 54.3(c). No financial terms were disclosed. The filing is a routine board seat change tied to a contractual nomination right, not a forced executive departure; classification as a management change is conservative given the designation mechanic.
